summary: Iteration 44: App.js Refactoring Verification Complete. All 17 frontend tests passed. The refactoring from ~800 lines to ~160 lines with 3 custom hooks and 6 components works correctly with no regressions.

signup_link.details: Sign Up link (data-testid=go-to-signup) present on login page

branch_toggle.details: Branch toggle (data-testid=branch-toggle) switches between Included/Excluded states

critical_code_review_comments: All data-testid attributes preserved from original implementation
Custom hooks properly encapsulate state logic
No linting errors in any refactored files
All existing flows work without regression
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 44 verified App.js refactoring: 1) App.js reduced from ~800 to ~160 lines. 2) 3 custom hooks (useAuth, useIdleTimeout, useCompany) work correctly. 3) 6 components (LoginPage, PublicRouter, AppNavbar, SuperAdminLayout, PageRenderer, IdleWarningModal) render and function properly. 4) All data-testid attributes preserved. 5) All existing flows work without regression. 6) Mobile menu works at 390px viewport. 7) Public pages (Privacy, Terms, Refund, Contact, Social) all accessible. 8) Admin and Super Admin login flows work correctly. 9) FY selector, branch toggle, user menu all functional. 10) Logout clears token and returns to landing page.
